title: Small and Wide Angle X-Ray Scattering Studies of Biological Macromolecules in Solution
protocol: Use a needle to remove some sample from the sample container.
Fill the capillary with the sample, ensuring it is filled between 2 and 3 cm from the bottom.
Close the capillary by melting wax on its tip.
Unscrew the vacuum sample holder from the system.
Insert the unfused end of the capillary into the sample holder.
Place the holder back into the system and screw in place.
Switch the main power "ON" by pushing the green button.
Verify the Emergency "Shut-Off" button is in the extended position.
Press "R6" on the menu once the touch screen has loaded.
Turn the Standby key to the "ON" position.
Turn the X-ray Key to the "ON" position.
Wait for the touch screen to read standby levels (30 kV and 0.4 mA).
Turn the Standby Safety Key to the "OFF" position.
Press the "Start Cycle" button on the bottom of the touch screen.
Wait for the touch screen to read nominal power (50 kV and 1 mA).
Enter the configuration screen by pressing "R4" on the touch screen if a different power level is desired.
Turn the power switch to the "ON" position on the temperature control panel.
Press and hold the enter button on the chiller for about 4 seconds or until the temperature display indicates an actual temperature.
Press the up or down arrows to change the temperature setting.
Press the enter button once the desired set value is displayed to store that value.
Wait until the actual temperature reaches the desired set value.
Turn the power switch to the "OFF" position if the error "E 01" appears and follow chiller shutdown instructions.
Refill the bath unit with purified water if necessary after following the Chiller Shutdown procedure.
Perform the chiller Startup procedure again after refilling.
Press "enter" for approximately 4 seconds to initiate shutdown of the chiller.
Turn the power switch to the "OFF" position to complete the shutdown process.
Ensure the vacuum door is secured in place before turning on the vacuum.
Turn the Vacuum 1 and 2 knobs to the "ON" positions.
Wait until the VAP5 vacuum gauge reads a vacuum level less than 1.5 mbar.
Verify the Main Pressure Gauge of the reduction valve is at least 10 bar.
Open the Main Valve.
Slowly open the Operating Pressure Valve until the pressure reaches 8 bar at the Operating Pressure Gauge.
Open the Second Main Valve.
Turn the knob to the vertical position on the Gas Control panel to open the Main Pressure valve.
Adjust the flow rate with the needle valve until the gauge reads approximately 8 bar.
Turn the Main Power switch to the "ON" position.
Activate the high voltage by turning the switch to the "ON" position.
Slowly turn the voltage control knob until approximately 3.5kV is reached on the gauge.
Go to Menu → Options → Enter channels and corresponding intensities in ASA 3.3.
Change filter, top left 1 mm Nickel (beam filter).
Set position 32,000 (range 28,000 to 32,000, critical region around 28,000) → go to position.
Make sure vacuum is below 5 mbar.
Ensure the detector is reading between 1k - 10K.
Run for 10 sec for approximately 52 counts per sec.
Change the energy windows.
Measure the energy window with the sample only, not including the filter case.
Set the final run for 10 seconds.
Find the location of the primary beam.
Change the filter again to 2 mm Tungsten (W, beam stopper).
Start from 30,000 and find the location of all other peaks of the samples.
Use ImageJ-macro software to calibrate SAXS - making transitions from intensity vs. channel to intensity vs. q (or d spacing).
Use ImageJ-macro software to calibrate WAXS - making transitions from intensity vs. channel to intensity vs. q (or d spacing).
Click on Live Data→ TPF tab→ Save file in ASA 3.3 software.
Enter the "a", lambda, and d values, as well as the center of gravity in EasySWAXS Device Settings tab.
Select Point Collimation.
Select Globular particle type unless it is known to be a rod or flat shaped particle.
Drag vertical lines on the I vs. q2 graph to surround a section of approximately linear slope.
Continue to drag the vertical lines closer together until the validation value is between 1 and 2.
Verify that safety and fast shutters are closed.
Turn the Standby key to the "ON" position.
Wait for the touchscreen to read standby levels.
Press R5 on the touchscreen.
Reduce the current to 0 A.
Reduce the voltage to 0 A.
Turn the X-ray key to the "OFF" position.
Switch the main power "OFF" by pushing the red off button.
